This setup guide gets you from download to first safe Abyss session without max settings that fail in replays.
Start with portal Abyss presets

Load the Abyss preset in your operator portal before customizing. Presets use high aim smoothness, chest-priority targeting on players that need it, and Hotkey macros disabled until you enable heal and mobility macros manually once per game to learn timings.
Save a copy as my_Abyss before edits—instance preset can diverge with lower delays without corrupting Abyss safety.
Prediction and Target Priority
Prediction leads moving targets for skill chains, interrupts, or ranged finishers. Target Priority picks the lowest HP player in range or focus-fire call target.
Set selector to prefer stun targets for supports—healers and controllers—not random nearest bot. DPS profiles prefer lowest HP target in script range.
Hotkey macros for clutch items
Bind Hotkey macros to fire shield potion before script combo when three enemies are within radius, or shield on channeling castors. Add 80–120 ms delay so item use precedes peeks naturally.
Overlapping instant heals plus instant aim snaps looks robotic in replays—review one replay weekly with conservative settings.
per-class aimbot profiles
Save separate profiles for staff, bow, and gun—examples in [Skill aim assist guide](/blog/aion-2-skill-script-guide/). Hotkey swap in player select without reopening loader.
instance preset can use lower delays; Abyss preset stays conservative until you have ten clean games at current delay values.
Patch day and anti-cheat discipline
After every Aion 2 update, run [anti-cheat patch day checklist](/blog/anticheat-patch-day-checklist/) before Abyss PvP. Script offsets break silently—private instance verify combo fire before rank.
Read aion2cheats.net status banner; yellow means wait even if yesterday’s session was clean.
